cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tapped your desk twice, so I've tapped mine. Bring that empty box over here, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking whether the desk wobbles. What do you need the box for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, checking. Put it on my desk first; I'd like one request carried out before the questions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on your desk. Can I get back to packing now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take it back and bring it here once more. This time, stay until I tell you to go.

reason: Use misunderstood attention signal as a compliance test; B completed errand and wish to return to work cause greater inconvenience.
